I replied to Hollis in the DM and confirmed the note: Caspian Halvorsen is now their go-to contact at Marrow Agrisupply for escalations on the Nettle rollout.

I didn't take any other action. The workspace brain saves direct messages automatically and shows them only to the member who wrote them, so the note will be there for Hollis when they ask later. Under the DM-privacy rule, I won't pass it on to anyone else.
